name: profile card, then an aggregator list builds row by row
looks: A small profile card (avatar, name, a short bio, two buttons) fades up beside a headline. It cuts to a new headline next to a card that fills in top to bottom with project rows, each a coloured icon, a name, a dollar figure and a live badge, the newest row always the sharpest while the card itself grows taller to fit.
build: The profile card is one DOM block, fading and sliding up 8px, power2.out. The list card builds with one row per beat (opacity 0->1, y 8px->0, ~0.3s), the card height tweening open to fit new rows; every landed row stays at full contrast as more are added beneath it, unlike a dimming stack.
sound: A soft whoosh as the profile card lands, a tick per list row, slightly louder as later rows carry bigger figures.
prompt: Show a small profile card fading in, then cut to a headline beside a card that fills in top to bottom with short project rows (an icon, a name, a figure, a status badge), the card growing taller as each new row lands and every row staying legible once added.
